A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the circum- stellar envelope of HD 56126 is composed of amorphous carbon and magnesium sulfide, which is the same as found in most other post-AGB stars.
the circumstellar environment of HD 56126 can be well described by a single dust condensation zone, which is consistent with a single mass-loss event.
the circumstellar envelope is dominated by amorphous carbon with a small fraction of MgS and TiC.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dust in the circumstellar envelope around HD 56126 is a mix of carbonaceous and sulfidic grains.
the circumstellar envelope around HD 56126 has been shaped by a very short, but intense, phase of mass loss.
